description: Create an in-app placement: a slot in the customer's app that shows in-app content inline, such as a home screen hero. The key is what app code passes to the SDK and never changes. Up to 50 per workspace.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

description.description: Where the slot sits in the app, up to 500 characters.

height.description: Height hint in points (1-4000) for whoever writes the content; null clears it.

key.description: 1-64 lowercase letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores, starting with a letter or number, e.g. home_hero.

name.description: Name shown in the dashboard, up to 100 characters.

width.description: Width hint in points (1-4000) for whoever writes the content; null clears it.

name: create_in_app_placement

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `create_in_app_placement` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

placement.description: The in-app placement record returned by Sequenzy.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
